evidence: The precursor for the HfO2 film was HfCl4. Bismuth (III) acetate (Bi(CH3CO2)3), lanthanum-acetate hydrate (La(CH3CO2)·xH2O), and titanium (IV) isopropoxide (Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4) were used as precursors, and the solvents were acetic acid (CH3CO2H) and 2-methoxyethanol (CH3OCH2CH2OH). The ALD cycle for depositing HfO2 films was set to obtain the final thicknesses of 5 – 20 nm. The base pressure was in the mid 10 mTorr, and O3 was used as an oxidant.
